description: Base capability for the Anthers Studio window: core IPC (sign-in and encode commands), event listening (the shell emits `desktop-auth-code` and `encode-progress`), opening the authorize page in the SYSTEM browser, and picking a video to encode. Filesystem scope is deliberately narrow — the webview may read back the encoder's own temp output, and nothing else. ffmpeg itself is spawned from Rust, so the webview gets no shell scope at all.
